title: Accepted Goal A shell decisions
summary: Canonical decisions accepted for Goal A without authorizing Goals B or C.

decisions.decision: Replace closed binding enums and compiler matches with one typed provider-owned BindingRegistry.
decisions.reason: New admitted bindings must not require a central component-ID branch.

decisions.decision: Project configuration selects registered IDs and data only; project executable adapters and arbitrary paths are forbidden.
decisions.reason: Shell extensibility must preserve fail-closed static-site security.

decisions.decision: Use one semantic docara.navigation with header, tree and compact Views/presets.
decisions.reason: Presentation variants do not justify component-ID proliferation or a renderer branch.

decisions.decision: Use versioned shell capability IDs instead of DOM selectors or component-name policy.
decisions.reason: Layout and project contributions need a stable typed compatibility boundary.

decisions.decision: Keep the outer page and document head application-owned.
decisions.reason: Metadata, asset order, locale, security bootstrap and receipts remain trusted boundaries.

decisions.decision: Goal A is additive-first and default output must remain byte-identical.
decisions.reason: Existing sites cannot silently change when safe extension points are added.

decisions.decision: Goals B and C require sequential independent acceptance and are not authorized by Goal A activation.
decisions.reason: The product track remains bounded and auditable.
